company.shortDescription: Honeydue is a mobile app for couples that offers tools to share information on respective account balances and spending.
company.description:
Honeydue is a mobile app that aims to reduce money-related arguments between couples by offering tools to share information on respective account balances and spending.

The app also lets couples stay on top of money matters in other ways, such as being able to comment on individual transactions and manage bill reminders together.

productsAndServices.description: A mobile application that allows couples to share and manage their financial account balances and spending information together.

productsAndServices.description: A banking service that allows couples to have joint bank accounts and cards, currently available via a waitlist.
